SynchronousCommand.Description: Install the Windows Console guest helper
SynchronousCommand.CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$media = [IO.DriveInfo]::GetDrives() | Where-Object { $_.DriveType -eq 'CDRom' -and $_.IsReady -and $_.VolumeLabel -eq 'CONSOLE_TOOLS' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $media) { exit 1 }; & (Join-Path $media.RootDirectory.FullName 'install.cmd'); exit $LASTEXITCODE"
